name: Lavender
use: Scent for the wardrobe, a feast for bees.
description: A shrubby perennial with grey-green leaves and fragrant purple flower spikes.
growing: Needs full sun and poor, well-drained soil. Cut it back lightly after flowering, but not into the old wood.
tip: Use culinary lavender sparingly: a pinch in shortbread or lemonade is enough, as too much tastes soapy.
